boundary: Native highlight Server-Timing includes first-use regex/syntax initialization and tokenization together. Request duration ends at resource response completion; outside-server time is request duration minus the total server phase, including transport/queueing and clock precision. Worker outside-engine time is request-to-reply duration minus initialization, grammar initialization and tokenization: it includes worker startup, queueing, structured cloning and message handling, not isolated transport alone. Sums describe work across requests, not additive wall-clock stages; negative residuals are retained. Worker engine phases and DOM measurements remain in each set. Show code resources did not record Server-Timing, so only request duration is available there. Resource transferSize counts response bytes; request payload and worker message bytes were not separately counted. Only independently measured actions are included; request completion alone does not prove successful colouring.
